handoff.methodNote: State machines that are driven by class swaps are measurable in a hidden document via MutationObserver with timestamps — that closed the TextSwap dwell without any pixel. Conversely, SPA navigation inside the probe iframe collapses transform/sticky geometry (/pricing read 2068 instead of 4283 after router.push), so route sweeps may only be trusted for element identity, and a full document load (iframe.src = route) is required for heights.
